class BaseEnrService {
  getBaseUri(state, county, electionId, fileName) {
    const countyUrl = !county || county === '' ? '' : `/${county}`;
    return `/${state}${countyUrl}/${electionId}/${fileName}`;
  }
  getUri(state, county, electionId, version, fileName, lang) {
    const countyUrl = !county || county === '' ? '' : `/${county}`;
    const langUrl = !lang ? '' : `/${lang}`;
    return `/${state}${countyUrl}/${electionId}/${version}/json${langUrl}/${fileName}`;
  }
  getUriReports(host, state, county, electionId, version, fileName) {
    const countyUrl = !county || county === '' ? '' : `/${county}`;
    return `${host}/${state}${countyUrl}/${electionId}/${version}/reports/${fileName}`;
  }
}
